title: Vial of gold flakes: 'It's all about the moon'

tellings.quote: forget about all this other stuff. It's all about the moon. He slams this little vial down. I pick it up. I look at it and I'm like and I shake it like it's a snow globe, but there's no liquid in it.

plain: In 1996, at the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a television series about UFOs, a man known as the captain is said to have slammed a small vial down on the desk and said to forget everything else, because it is all about the moon. A screenwriter named Brent Friedman tells Michels he was there: he picked up the vial and shook it like a snow globe, but there was no liquid in it, only what is described as flakes of gold.
